Nebraska precinct map research

765 ordered historical observations · 58 priority parents · all 1,326 observations and 93 parents retained

Historical named-canvass dispatch only. 2024 ClassII special: 748,190 / 935,005 named Ricketts/Love votes. Eligible write-in membership robustness is unproved. Every map is a qualified shared-parent resource; no entry-level legal/native/physical/current match is established. Census2020 VTDs are historical alternatives, not current precincts.

603 entries in 17 parents have shared county/municipal map resources; 162 entries in 41 parents use Census2020 only. These resource counts do not prove entry-level coverage or that city-only maps cover a whole county.

Original PDFs and source-native data work offline. SVG/PNG previews are display derivatives with no basemap or vote allocation. Each source response, error, schema and native geometry remains byte-pinned. No external JavaScript or network request is needed by this index.

Machine index and full contract references · 765-entry CSV · Original shared receipts · Full owned asset manifest
